mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.debit),0) FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv ON bvr.voucher_id = bv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs ON bs.subject_id = bvr.subject_id where bv.year_period = #{yearPeriod} and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code like CONCAT(#{subjectCode},'%') and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0';

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(bvr.credit),0) FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv ON bvr.voucher_id = bv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs ON bs.subject_id = bvr.subject_id where bv.year_period = #{yearPeriod} and bv.book_id = #{bookId} and bs.code like CONCAT(#{subjectCode},'%') and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0';

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0)) - SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),0) FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_subject_type bst on bs.type_id = bst.type_id where bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bst.`name` = '损益' and bv.year_period = #{period} and bs.balance_direction = 'CREDIT' and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)) - SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0)),0) FROM `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_subject_type bst on bs.type_id = bst.type_id where bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bst.`name` = '损益' and bv.year_period = #{period} and bs.balance_direction = 'DEBIT' and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0'

SELECT '结转损益' summary,bvr.subject_id,'DEBIT' balance_direction,'借' balance_direction_text, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0)) - SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)),0) DEBIT,bvr.supplier_id,bvr.customer_id, bvr.project_id,bvr.department_id,bvr.person_id,bvr.stock_id from `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_subject_type bst on bs.type_id = bst.type_id where bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bst.`name` = '损益' and bv.year_period = #{period} and bs.balance_direction = 'CREDIT' and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY bvr.subject_id,balance_direction,balance_direction_text,bvr.supplier_id,bvr.customer_id,bvr.project_id,bvr.department_id,bvr.person_id,bvr.stock_id

SELECT '结转损益' summary,bvr.subject_id,'CREDIT' balance_direction,'贷' balance_direction_text, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(bvr.debit,0)) - SUM(IFNULL(bvr.credit,0)),0) credit,bvr.supplier_id,bvr.customer_id, bvr.project_id,bvr.department_id,bvr.person_id,bvr.stock_id from `book_voucher_record` bvr LEFT JOIN book_voucher bv on bv.voucher_id = bvr.voucher_id LEFT JOIN book_subject bs on bvr.subject_id = bs.subject_id LEFT JOIN book_subject_type bst on bs.type_id = bst.type_id where bs.book_id = #{bookId} and bst.`name` = '损益' and bv.year_period = #{period} and bs.balance_direction = 'DEBIT' and bv.del_flag = '0' and bvr.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY bvr.subject_id,balance_direction,balance_direction_text,bvr.supplier_id,bvr.customer_id,bvr.project_id,bvr.department_id,bvr.person_id,bvr.stock_id
